# Market Making and Inventory Control {#plan-ch18}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Studies bid and ask decisions when the trader earns spread but accumulates inventory and adverse-selection risk.

**Subtopics.** Reservation prices; Avellaneda-Stoikov; inventory penalties; quote skew; order-arrival calibration; fill probabilities; adverse selection; queue-aware quoting; volatility and regime changes; latency; multi-asset inventory; practical limits of stylized models.
